about: I'm a Backend & AI Engineer and Associate Solution Architect at Iron Mountain, sitting at the intersection of enterprise Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) platforms, agentic AI systems, and high-scale backend engineering.

At Iron Mountain, I design and ship end-to-end agentic AI workflows (LangGraph, RAG, MCP), build LLM-based custom AI processors that transform heterogeneous unstructured documents into schema-aligned outputs, and develop Python (FastAPI) & Java (Spring Boot) APIs that power mission-critical enterprise workloads.
My engineering foundation spans building production backend systems, scalable SDKs, and automated AWS CI/CD infrastructure — from Terraform & Docker to Jenkins, ECS/Fargate, and Kubernetes.
I write about what I build. My technical articles break down architecture patterns, LLM agent pipelines, and backend engineering decisions for the developer community.

experience.title: Associate Solution Architect
responsibilities: Improved structured-data generation and document classification accuracy by 18% by designing and developing end-to-end agentic AI workflows for an enterprise Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) platform.

Reduced manual document processing time by 30 hours per week by building and evaluating LLM-based custom AI processors that transform heterogeneous, unstructured documents into schema-aligned outputs.

Increased search retrieval speed by 45% by engineering an alternative ingestion path through Google Cloud Storage that enables vector embeddings, full-text search and Elasticsearch indexing for externally generated OCR text/JSON.
Accelerated partner integration testing by 40% by building a comprehensive API integration library with webhook testing against Stripe and mock REST APIs.
Reduced repeat partner support tickets by 25% by writing SDK usage guides, reference workflows and troubleshooting runbooks for the developer platform.

Facilitated the rapid onboarding of 6 enterprise clients by leading cross-functional communication between product, engineering, QA and client stakeholders, supporting SDK development and workflow deployments, running system-integrator enablement sessions, and translating architecture decisions into business impact.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer Intern
responsibilities: Reduced average deployment time from 45 minutes to under 10 minutes by building and maintaining Jenkins CI/CD pipelines that automate Docker image builds, Amazon ECR pushes and AWS ECS/Fargate deployments.
Decreased infrastructure provisioning time by 70% by using Terraform to deploy AWS resources (EC2, S3, EBS, VPC) and bootstrapping Python on remote nodes for Ansible.
Eliminated 8 hours of manual setup per week by automating server configurations with Ansible playbooks and deploying centralized Grafana monitoring for internal Git and Jenkins labs.
Kept configuration consistent across 20+ servers by replacing ad-hoc changes with idempotent, version-controlled Ansible roles and Git pull-request reviews.

experience.title: Web Developer (Part-time)
responsibilities: Supported up to 500 concurrent users with zero downtime by developing Java/Spring Boot REST APIs and server-rendered features for analytics, seat booking and order processing.
Improved database query performance by 35% by designing optimized PostgreSQL and MongoDB schemas and managing versioned database migrations with Flyway.
Reduced API error rates by 45% by implementing robust request validation and centralized error handling across all application endpoints.

experience.title: DevOps Trainee
responsibilities: Achieved 99% workload reliability across 50+ pods in hands-on simulated environments by containerizing 3+ applications with Docker, managing Kubernetes workloads with RBAC, and troubleshooting networking and cluster issues.

Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, S3, ECS, Fargate, ECR, EKS)

projects.title: Text-to-SQL Multi-Agent System
projects.description: Let non-technical users query PostgreSQL in plain English with 90% query accuracy on a 100-question test set through a 5-agent pipeline (Planner, Generator, Validator, Executor, Explainer) served by FastAPI. Blocked 100% of destructive statements (DROP, DELETE) in testing and cut hallucinated tables and columns by 70% by enforcing read-only guardrails and grounding generation in schema and sample-row context.

projects.title: VeydrakCLI – AI Coding Agent
projects.description: Made multi-file AI code changes safe to apply, with zero edits reaching the real repository before tests pass and a human approves, by building a LangGraph agent that plans with Pydantic, generates in a map-reduce fan-out and self-tests with pytest in a sandbox. Cut routine refactor time by 50% by giving the agent AST, grep and glob tools to map code before planning.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Deep Researcher
projects.description: Produced citation-audited research reports from 3 web search tiers (Tavily, DuckDuckGo, Wikipedia) plus local PDF/Word/Markdown files by orchestrating supervisor-led agents with LanceDB RAG. Reduced unsupported claims in final reports by 60% by adding fact-checking, contradiction-detection and gap-filling follow-up query loops.

projects.title: CoffeeHouse Inventory Management System
projects.description: Cut deployment effort by 80% while processing 200+ transactions by building 15+ SOLID-based components, a reusable SDK and a Jenkins, Docker and Argo CD delivery pipeline.

projects.title: Hospital Management & Ticket Booking Systems
projects.description: Reduced administrative workload by 60% across 100+ patient records by automating scheduling and report generation with Spring Boot REST APIs and webhook events. Improved booking accuracy by 95% with zero data loss in testing by implementing venue-capacity checks and double-booking prevention.

projects.title: Python Stripe SDK & Video Processing Service
projects.description: Cut payment-integration setup time by 70% across projects by packaging a pip-installable Stripe SDK for products and checkout sessions with cryptographic webhook signature verification. Automated S3-to-S3 media processing for 500+ videos by building a FastAPI service on MoviePy and FFmpeg, containerized with Docker and run under systemd on EC2.
